title: What are Operators?
overview: Operators are symbols or keywords used to perform operations on values and variables. Python provides different types of operators for calculations, comparisons, and logic.

title: Arithmetic Operators
overview: Arithmetic operators are used to perform mathematical calculations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

example.title: Arithmetic Example
example.content:
+  Addition
-  Subtraction
*  Multiplication
/  Division
%  Modulus
** Power
// Floor Division

title: Comparison Operators
overview: Comparison operators compare two values and return a boolean result (True or False).

title: Logical Operators
overview: Logical operators are used to combine multiple conditions. Python provides and, or, and not operators.

example.title: Logical Example

title: Assignment Operators
overview: Assignment operators are used to assign values to variables and update existing values.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned different Python operators including arithmetic, comparison, logical, and assignment operators used for performing operations on data.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Arithmetic operators perform calculations.
✔ Comparison operators compare values.
✔ Logical operators combine conditions.
✔ Assignment operators update variables.
